Cc: Acme Health TalentOps <talentops@acmehealth.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@example.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final loop scheduling: Samir Rao — pairing & overlap handling

Hi all,

We have Samir Rao (SWE) in final loop next week — Acme Health is offering two back-to-back 45-min interviewer blocks for the hiring day on Wednesday 11/25 (candidate is only available that day). We are short on panel capacity that morning because of overlapping candidate waves across teams.

Proposal:
- Run the two final interviews as paired slots ("duet" format): one person leads technical deep-dive, the other focuses on system design/context and role fit.
- Assign a 15-minute overlap buffer between sessions so we can hand off if one runs long. If a session runs over, the second interviewer will cover the remaining time but still score independently.

Please reply with which of these windows you can cover and which pairing you prefer. If you can’t do any of the morning slots, indicate if you can backfill the 1:00–2:30pm flexible window (we’d cascade someone in).

Available windows (PST):
- 8:30–10:00 (two 45-min interviews with 15-min buffer)
- 10:30–12:00 (same)
- 13:00–14:30 (flex/backfill)

Attachments: Samir_Rao_Resume.pdf (resume + portfolio)

Notes: Acme asked that one interviewer per pair has system-design experience and the other handles behavior/ownership questions. I’m including TalentOps on cc to keep them in the loop about overlap handling.

Thanks — please reply by EOD Tuesday so I can lock invites.

—
Irene Choi
Recruiting Coordinator | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
